interpretation: Neither arm selected a page that the fixture explicitly marked as another gold page.
This does not prove the selected pages are true negatives: TechQA gold annotations can be incomplete and only a human or independent relevance judge can audit unmarked pages.
LaBSE therefore has higher inequality-valid candidate coverage on this fixture, not demonstrated higher negative quality or retrieval quality.
The audit is a public-document proxy and does not test corporate aliases, identifier collisions, schema versions, or tool outcomes.
